item.title: Needle 2 Explained: A 14MB On-Device Tool-Calling Model
item.description: In August 2026, YC-backed Cactus Compute released Needle 2: 45M parameters, quantized to CQ2 the whole model ships as a single 14MB binary, a full session peaks at about 28MB of RAM, Apache-2.0 licensed, with a paper on arXiv (2607.18363). The official tagline is “foundation model for tiny devices,” but it is not a multi-billion-parameter language foundation model — it does exactly one thing: take a user instruction plus tool schemas, and emit a JSON function call.
